picks.headline: Ubisoft's calling its next push into gen-AI game development Motherbrain, according to new trademarks from the Assassin's Creed maker
picks.excerpt: Ubisoft has been quite enthusiastic about generative AI's use in game development, and a new trademark might sound familiar to Nintendo and Metroid fans.
picks.rationale: Freshest item in the pool: new trademark filings show a major AAA publisher branding its next gen-AI development push. No Ubisoft Motherbrain story has run in games before.

picks.headline: An unofficial Super Mario Galaxy PC port is in the works, with the developers proudly claiming it's "100% coded by humans"
picks.excerpt: An unofficial Super Mario Galaxy PC port is in the works, with developers proudly claiming it is '100% coded by humans' as vibe-coded AI ports of Donkey Kong 64, Mario Kart Wii and Monster Hunter flood the scene.
picks.rationale: A new port project that uses 'human-coded' as its selling point against the flood of vibe-coded ports. It is a separate event from the earlier Donkey Kong 64, Mario Kart Wii and Ocarina port cards.

picks.headline: Radeon RX 9070 XT Finally Touches 75 FPS At 1080p In Cyberpunk 2077 With DLSS 5, Thanks To The Efforts Of DLSS-NR-on-AMD Developer
picks.excerpt: DLSS-NR-on-AMD boosts performance by up to 49% on RX 9000 series, enabling 75 FPS in Cyberpunk 2077 at 1080p, up from 30 FPS
picks.rationale: The only DLSS 5 card allowed today. It reports a new milestone: the cross-vendor neural-rendering port went from 30 to 75 FPS, which is new news beyond the 09-05 'modder enables it' card. Chosen over the PC Gamer Miku hands-on, which repeats the stylized-art complaint from the 09-26 Smash Melee card.

picks.headline: Twitch CEO Dan Clancy says platform doesn't need AI disclosure rules — for now
picks.excerpt: Twitch CEO Dan Clancy believes the nature of livestreamed content insulates the platform against the need for an AI disclosure policy.
picks.rationale: A platform-policy position from Twitch's CEO on AI disclosure, which contrasts with Steam's mandate. This is a different story from the 09-24 Kotaku card on Twitch's AI stream-coach opt-out.

picks.headline: PlayStation 5 Pro's PSSR Strikes Another Victory, As Final Fantasy VII Revelation Director Promises 4K@60 FPS
picks.excerpt: Final Fantasy VII Revelation will target 4K 60 FPS on PS5 Pro using PSSR, and hands-on gamescom testing proves it
picks.rationale: A console ML upscaler (PSSR) confirmed as the route to 4K60 in a major AAA release. This covers the console side of AI reconstruction and is separate from the 08-09 PSSR 2.0 toggle card.
